name: The Garden Society: Kykuit
source:
Recent transfer student and new member of the Garden Society, will you be able to fit in? Make friends? …Or something more?

[From [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240711170219/http://renai.us/game/gsk.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
作为一名刚转学而来、新近加入“园艺社”的成员，你能否顺利融入这个集体、结交挚友……甚或收获一段超越友情的恋曲？

[摘自[url=http://web.archive.org/web/20240711170219/http://renai.us/game/gsk.shtml]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
